'''Marium Valmont''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She resided in [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. She helped the local [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] fend of the [[Zssik Clan/Legends|Zssik Clan]].
